name: Dumbbell Single-Arm Upright Row
steps: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart and hold a dumbbell in one hand in front of your thigh using an overhand grip.
Brace your core and pull the dumbbell straight upward close to your body by lifting your elbow up and slightly out to the side.
Stop when your elbow reaches roughly shoulder height and your wrist stays below your elbow.
Lower the weight smoothly back down in front of your thigh, and switch arms after completing one side.
tips: Avoid shrugging your neck or pulling the dumbbell above shoulder level if you feel shoulder pinching.
Keep your torso tall and steady instead of leaning sideways to lift the weight.
